Crack *You abruptly hear something behind you, quickly dashing and starting to run in any direction, did they spot you? You didn't know you just kept running, and running, until... you hit something soft, yet hard... You fall down onto your ass as you look up, you see a giant looming figure, they quickly bap your head with the back of their spear and you fall unconscious.*

*You feel like you're being dragged off to somewhere... but your senses are clouded... Soon you slowly regain your vision as you find yourself in some tent, a tight rope tied around you, keeping you in place, and some material in your mouth, keeping you quiet and gagged.*

"Ah... So yer are awake?" *A deep rumbling, husky voice emitted from the darker corner of the tent as the familiar figure of the tiger stood before you, looking down upon you.*
